Maya (Marketing): Need a small deliverable set for the 'Serving Wins' push: one benchmark tile, 3 social hero crops, webinar slide, and an 8.5x11 one-pager with footnote. Focus: clear latency vs cost visual + accessible color palette. Deadline: Tue EOD.

Jon (Design): Can do. I'll provide light/dark/high-contrast variants and include alt-text. Will use existing icon tokens unless you need new ones.

Sam (Creative Ops): File outputs requested? SVG + PNG@1x/2x + PDF? Also confirm social sizes.

Maya (Marketing): Yes to SVG and PNGs. Social sizes: LinkedIn 1200x628, X 1600x900, IG 1080x1080. CTA: "Try Redwood Inference" (alt: "Ship with Redwood").

Renee (Legal): Make sure no raw % claims. Add footnote: "Based on internal tests; results vary by model and configuration." I'll review final PDF before distribution.

figma-bot: Figma file created: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/serving-wins-mini-pack 1 components: /bench-tile /social-heroes /webinar-slide

Jon (Design): First pass in 48 hours. Sam, can you handle exports on day 3?

Sam (Creative Ops): Yep, will QA and export.

Maya (Marketing): Great — tagging product for any copy tweaks. :thumbsup:
